scenario_summary: Customer is locked out of his account due to missing credentials and is requesting a refund for an unknown order without an order number.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Scott Wagner and I'm 67. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.

Hello, Mr. Wagner. I understand how frustrating it can be to lose access to your account while away from your usual device. For your security, I cannot access account details based on name alone. To proceed, I need to verify your identity using at least two pieces of information, such as your billing address, the last four digits of the credit card used, or the approximate date of your last purchase.
Oh, I see. I think I can remember the billing address. It's 422 Maple Street, Springfield. And I believe I used my Visa ending in 4492.

Thank you, Mr. Wagner. That matches our records. I have successfully located your account. Regarding the refund, our 'Order Adjustment Policy' requires an order number to initiate a return or refund, as we must verify the transaction date and item eligibility within our system. Since you don't have the order number, I can search for recent transactions associated with your card.
That would be great. I think it was for a coffee maker I bought about three weeks ago. I just never received it.

I see a transaction for a coffee maker dated three weeks ago, order #CM-99281. Since the tracking shows the item was marked as delivered but you haven't received it, I have initiated a 'Lost in Transit' refund request per our shipping policy. The refund of $89.99 has been processed back to your Visa ending in 4492 and should appear within 3-5 business days.
That is a huge relief, thank you so much for your help today.
You're very welcome, Mr. Wagner. I'm glad we could get that sorted for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

resolution_summary: Agent verified the customer using billing address and card details, located the missing order, and processed a refund for the non-delivered item.
